name: B10-0506/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 16 October 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2429 as regards origin labelling for fruit and vegetables originating in the non-self-governing territory of Western Sahara
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission rule on labels for fruit and vegetables from Western Sahara. The Parliament says the rule would let these products carry vague labels instead of clearly stating Western Sahara as the place of origin. It argues this could mislead shoppers, break European Union food information law, and set a bad example. The Parliament formally objects to the rule and says it cannot come into force.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament objects to the Commission's labelling rule, so it cannot enter into force.
- **Who it affects:** Shoppers, farmers and traders of fruit and vegetables from Western Sahara.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is told the rule is blocked; member states are informed.
